items.title: 14.1.4 Magnitude of a Vector in Space (Roman Urdu)

blocks.title: Numbering note
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ko 14.1.5 chhaapti hai (Book# 14.1.5). Kitab mein 14.1.1 naam ki koi heading hai hi nahin, is liye portal 14.1 ke sub-headings ko tarteeb se 14.1.1 se 14.1.8 tak number karta hai. Yahan 14.1.4 wahi hai jo kitab mein 14.1.5 hai.

Plane mein humne dekha tha ke magnitude asal mein Pythagoras hai. Space mein bhi bilkul wahi hai, bas Pythagoras do dafa lagta hai: ek dafa farsh par, aur ek dafa unchai ke saath. Yeh subtopic chhota hai lekin poore unit mein har jagah kaam aayega: unit vector, distance, direction cosines, sab is formula par khare hain.
Space mein vector \(\underline{u}\) ki magnitude (norm ya length) hum point \(P(x, y, z)\) ke origin \(O\) se faasle ke taur par define karte hain:

blocks.text_alt: magnitude of OP equals magnitude of u equals square root of x squared plus y squared plus z squared

blocks.alt: Axes x, y, z from O. An arrow labelled u goes from O to the point P(x, y, z); dashed lines of lengths x, y and z show its coordinates.
blocks.caption: Magnitude of u: the distance of P(x, y, z) from the origin O (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kyun: teen squares kyun? Pythagoras do dafa lagaiye. Farz karein \(Q(x, y, 0)\) farsh par \(P\) ke bilkul neeche wala point hai.
Farsh mein: \(OQ^{2} = x^{2} + y^{2}\) (pehla Pythagoras).
Unchai \(QP = |z|\) seedhi khari hai, yani \(OQ\) par perpendicular; is liye triangle \(OQP\) mein right angle \(Q\) par hai: \(OP^{2} = OQ^{2} + z^{2} = x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}\) (doosra Pythagoras).
Misaal: \(|[2, 3, 6]| = \sqrt{4 + 9 + 36} = \sqrt{49} = 7\).

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Hamari practice.) Kamre ka saiz 3 m x 4 m x 12 m ho to ek kone se bilkul saamne wale oonche kone tak ki seedhi lambai kitni hai? Yeh vector \([3, 4, 12]\) ki magnitude hai:
\(\sqrt{3^{2} + 4^{2} + 12^{2}} = \sqrt{9 + 16 + 144} = \sqrt{169} = 13\) m.
Tasdeeq: farsh ka diagonal \(\sqrt{9 + 16} = 5\), phir \(\sqrt{5^{2} + 12^{2}} = 13\). Do qadam wala Pythagoras bhi wahi jawab deta hai.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.problem: For the vectors \(\underline{u} = [1, -2, 3]\), \(\underline{v} = [2, 1, 3]\) and \(\underline{w} = [-1, 4, 0]\), find the following: (i) \(\underline{v} + \underline{w}\) (ii) \(2\underline{w}\) (iii) \(|\underline{u}|\) (iv) \(|\underline{v} - 2\underline{w}|\) (v) \(|2\underline{u} - \underline{v} + 3\underline{w}|\)
steps:
Given: \(\underline{u} = [1, -2, 3]\), \(\underline{v} = [2, 1, 3]\), \(\underline{w} = [-1, 4, 0]\).
To find: (i) aur (ii) mein vectors, aur (iii) se (v) tak magnitudes.
Method: sab se pehle dekhte hain ke kya maanga hai. Jama aur scalar se zarb component ba component (14.1.3). Magnitude ke liye \(|[x, y, z]| = \sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}}\). Jab kisi combination ki magnitude maangi ho to pehle poora vector banaiye, phir magnitude lijiye.

(i) \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) ko jama karein
\[\underline{v} + \underline{w} = [2 - 1,\ 1 + 4,\ 3 + 0]\]
\[= [1, 5, 3]\]
Kyun: vectors component ba component jama hote hain: x ke saath x, y ke saath y, z ke saath z.

(ii) \(\underline{w}\) ko 2 se zarb
\[2\underline{w} = 2[-1, 4, 0]\]
\[= [-2, 8, 0]\]
Kyun: scalar har component ko zarb karta hai, sirf pehle ko nahin. Sifar ko 2 se zarb karne par sifar hi rehta hai.

(iii) \(\underline{u}\) ki magnitude
\[|\underline{u}| = |[1, -2, 3]|\]
\[= \sqrt{(1)^{2} + (-2)^{2} + (3)^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{1 + 4 + 9} = \sqrt{14}\]
Kyun: magnitude ka formula. \((-2)^{2} = 4\) positive hai; negative ko bracket mein likh kar square karein taa ke sign ki ghalti na ho. \(\sqrt{14}\) mazeed simple nahin hota, is liye jawab yahi hai.

(iv) Pehle vector \(\underline{v} - 2\underline{w}\) banayein
\[\underline{v} - 2\underline{w} = [2 + 2,\ 1 - 8,\ 3 - 0]\]
\[= [4, -7, 3]\]
Kyun: (ii) se \(2\underline{w} = [-2, 8, 0]\). \(2 - (-2) = 2 + 2 = 4\): minus minus plus ban jaata hai.

(iv) Phir us ki magnitude
\[|\underline{v} - 2\underline{w}| = \sqrt{(4)^{2} + (-7)^{2} + (3)^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{16 + 49 + 9} = \sqrt{74}\]
Kyun: magnitude poore bane hue vector ki li jaati hai. \(|\underline{v}| - 2|\underline{w}|\) likhna ghalat hai, kyunke lambaiyan is tarah ghatti-barhti nahin.

(v) \(2\underline{u} - \underline{v} + 3\underline{w}\) banayein
\[2\underline{u} = [2, -4, 6],\quad 3\underline{w} = [-3, 12, 0]\]
\[[2, -4, 6] - [2, 1, 3] + [-3, 12, 0]\]
\[= [2 - 2 - 3,\ -4 - 1 + 12,\ 6 - 3 + 0]\]
\[= [-3, 7, 3]\]
Kyun: pehle har vector ko us ke scalar se zarb kijiye, phir milte julte components jama/minus kijiye. Ek line mein sab kuch karne ki koshish mein sign aksar ghalat ho jaata hai.

(v) Us ki magnitude
\[|2\underline{u} - \underline{v} + 3\underline{w}| = \sqrt{(-3)^{2} + (7)^{2} + (3)^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{9 + 49 + 9} = \sqrt{67}\]
Kyun: \([-3, 7, 3]\) par magnitude ka formula.

Tasdeeq:
(iv) doosre tareeqe se: \(\underline{v} - 2\underline{w} = \underline{v} + (-2)\underline{w} = [2, 1, 3] + [2, -8, 0] = [4, -7, 3]\). Wahi jawab.
(v) x-components: \(2 - 2 - 3 = -3\); y: \(-4 - 1 + 12 = 7\); z: \(6 - 3 + 0 = 3\). Wahi jawab.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Example 1 ke vectors se \(|\underline{u} + \underline{v}|\) nikaaliye aur dekhiye ke kya yeh \(|\underline{u}| + |\underline{v}|\) ke barabar hai.
Jawab: \(\underline{u} + \underline{v} = [3, -1, 6]\), \(|\underline{u} + \underline{v}| = \sqrt{9 + 1 + 36} = \sqrt{46} \approx 6.78\). Lekin \(|\underline{u}| + |\underline{v}| = \sqrt{14} + \sqrt{14} \approx 7.48\). Barabar nahin! Jama ki hui lambai hamesha alag alag lambaiyon ke jama se kam ya barabar hoti hai (triangle ki koi bhi side baaqi do ke jama se lambi nahin hoti).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
\(|[x, y, z]| = \sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2}}\): space ka Pythagoras.
Magnitude kabhi negative nahin; sirf zero vector ki magnitude sifar hai.
Kisi combination ki magnitude ke liye pehle vector banaiye, phir magnitude.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
\(|\underline{v} - 2\underline{w}| = |\underline{v}| - 2|\underline{w}|\) likh dena: magnitudes aise nahin judte.
Negative component ko bracket ke baghair square karna: \(-2^{2} = -4\) lekin \((-2)^{2} = 4\).
Aakhir mein square root lagana bhool jaana: \(|\underline{u}| = \sqrt{14}\), 14 nahin.
